reason: Existing handshake, record, reply and flow facts unchanged; implement platform I/O ports rather than reanalyze identical functions.
facts_reused: hello BE32(1,8), exact challenge and public-value message, uncompressed flag1/key8 record branch
UI type10 byte requests, type2 notices/type11 final and profile projection/selection
10s Windows timer and raw close/failure branches are static facts; strict core flow policies remain independent

port_contract.session: createLauncherSession receives explicit1..10 endpoints, first ordinal and request bytes, openStream; construction performs no network, no entropy request or account lookup. start executes one exchange; repeated start returns same Promise.
port_contract.stream: openStream(endpoint,{signal}) returns own read/write/close methods. read returns nonempty actual Uint8Array/ArrayBuffer<=64KiB or null EOF; write consumes ordered bytes and resolves on local completion, not peer acknowledgement; close is idempotent best-effort.
port_contract.entropy: Platform getRandomValues by default; exactly20 fresh bytes per reached challenge; explicit randomBytes override is labelled caller-provided and never claimed platform entropy. No Math.random fallback or native legacy hash generator.
port_contract.clock_timer: Monotonic safe integer milliseconds; one10s core deadline covers connect/read/write/entropy. Check absolute deadline before and after awaited success/rejection; AbortSignal cancels, late opened stream closed.
port_contract.cleanup: Dispose awaited/late ports, wipe owned exponent/chunk/output buffers best effort. Native close request/call completion is not remote-close proof; peer EOF verifies actual local adapter in test.
port_contract.limits: 4MiB cumulative inbound independent policy,64KiB per chunk; no empty-read spin, only pre-open finite failover, no credential replay.
port_contract.method_ownership: Capture accepted own read/write/close once; returned failure code/message is frozen metadata, not the mutable internal Error.

node_adapter.scope: Explicit allowed endpoint tuples only, no default official target/proxy. ASCII hostnames or unbracketed IP, decimal port1..65535. Socket AbortSignal/noDelay/highWaterMark64KiB; owned bounded reads/writes, one pending read/write per stream.
node_adapter.testing: Only127.0.0.1 ephemeral original Python/PyCryptodome oracle; independently derive key/decrypt credential frame and compare original known frame; no private exponent/key/request logging.

primary_sources.use: asynchronous TCP API, AbortSignal, highWaterMark and socket.destroy; actual runtime26.9.0 verified separately
getRandomValues fills typed arrays with cryptographically strong random values; runtime/browsers tested directly
